title: print page: a printed record does not carry its own title field (the invoice number INV-1010 is on neither PDF) — record:details hides the declared title field for a page:header, which a print page refuses
body:
Filing gate ①: a class-a finding from the os-dev report on objectui#12751 (PR #12785, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`). Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

reach: the live printed PDF. The dev booted the published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2` showcase backend, added a throwaway A4 `print` page on `showcase_invoice` whose `record:details` declares `name`, and printed INV-1010 to PDF with Chromium on both the record route and the named page route, before and after PR #12785. The invoice number is on none of the PDFs. The PNGs are on branch `claude/issue-12751-evidence` under `evidence/12751/`.

## Static read (objectui `main` `4857cd2`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:752`–`:754`: `declaredTitleField = declaredNameField(objSchema)`, and when the record has a value there it goes into `hideFieldNames`. The premise, in the comments above it, is that the page header's H1 already shows that value, so the details row would be a duplicate.
- The renderer never reads `usePrintPage()` (no match in the file).
- A print page refuses `page:header` (the spec's print contract), so on paper no header draws the title, and `record:details` still hides it. A printed invoice carries no invoice number.
- The `titleFormat` and candidate branches below `:755` hide a row on the same premise, so a print page whose object has no declared name field may drop its title-matching row the same way (not measured).

## For triage to scope

- The likely shape: on a print page the H1 dedupe does not apply, so `record:details` prints every field it declares, including the title field. That is the reading card ② of objectstack#8346 took for collapsed sections (objectui#12717: "`record:details` prints every field it declares").
- `DetailView` reads the print context since PR #12785, and `DetailSection` since PR #12729; this renderer would be the third reader of the same `usePrintPage()` context.

Dedupe: `search_issues` in objectui with "print page record title name field missing record:details hideFieldNames page:header" returned none, and with "printed record title does not print on print page" returned 4: #12751 (the approval strip, its sibling), #12717, #12715 and #11958 (all closed, other print defects). None covers the title field.
